data.name: Bob
data.message: Hey Diana, doing a task here. Let's buddy up afterwards?

data.name: Diana
data.message: Sure Bob, let's head towards upper engine and then medbay!

data.name: Eve
data.message: Hey Charlie, I'm just starting my scan here.

I just found Eve dead in medbay. My path this round was oxygen, then upper engine, and finally medbay. In oxygen, I bumped into Bob early on (around tick 4), so Bob can hopefully vouch for me being there. By the time I got to medbay, Eve was already dead on the floor and I didn't see anyone leaving the area, so the killer might have vented or moved on quickly. Any leads from the right side of the ship or storage?

Thanks Diana. So my round went medbay first — I actually saw Eve there briefly around tick 5, she was alive and seemed to be heading somewhere. I didn't stick around, I cut up through cafeteria and then over to electrical to start on calibration, which is where I was when you called this in. So if Eve was killed in medbay after I left, the timing window is between roughly tick 5 and when Diana arrived. Diana, do you remember what tick you got to medbay? That'd help us narrow the window. I'd really like to hear from Bob (since Diana mentioned seeing him in oxygen) and from Alice and Frank — nobody's accounted for the right side or storage yet.

I can absolutely vouch for Diana. My route this round was lower engine to upper engine, and then I headed up to oxygen. I saw Diana in oxygen right at tick 4, exactly like she said. I've just been in oxygen working on my filter task since then.

If Charlie saw Eve alive in medbay at tick 5, and Diana was up in oxygen with me at tick 4, the travel time makes it really unlikely that Diana is the killer. She'd have to fly across the map to get there and kill Eve before finding the body. Diana is pretty much cleared in my book, and I think Charlie is fairly safe too if he's the one giving us the timeline for when Eve was last alive. 

That means the killer almost certainly slipped into medbay right after Charlie left, probably between ticks 5 and 6. They could have come from storage, cafeteria, or maybe even vented. Alice and Frank, you guys are the big question marks right now. Where were you both during ticks 5 and 6? We need your locations to figure out who had access to medbay. Let's hold off on voting until we hear from them.

I've been on the far right side of the ship the entire round—started down in navigation, moved up through security, and I'm up in weapons now. I haven't seen a single person this whole time. 

Since I was nowhere near the left side or the middle where medbay is, I obviously couldn't have killed Eve, especially in that tight time window Charlie mentioned. Bob and Diana seem to clear each other for the early part of the round, and Charlie's timeline sounds reasonable. 

That leaves Frank as the biggest question mark. Frank, you're up next. Where were you, and did you pass near storage, cafeteria, or electrical around tick 5 or 6? Since we have no hard proof right now and I don't want to throw a random vote, I'm inclined to skip unless Frank's story completely falls apart. Let's hear what he has to say.

Hold on a second, Alice. Your story is completely made up. 

My route this round was starting in Security, and then I moved straight down to Navigation. I've been on the right side of the map the entire round. 

If you actually started in Navigation, moved up through Security, and went to Weapons, we would have absolutely crossed paths. There is only one hallway connecting Security and Navigation. I didn't see you in Security, I didn't see you in Navigation, and we didn't pass each other in the corridor. You weren't there.

Since I know for a fact you're lying about your location, you're obviously covering up where you actually were—which was probably slipping into Medbay right after Charlie left to kill Eve. 

Bob and Diana have practically cleared each other with their Oxygen meeting at tick 4, and Charlie is the one providing the timeline. Alice is giving a fake alibi because she's the Duck. We need to vote Alice right now.

Whoa, okay, Frank just blew this wide open. It definitely comes down to Alice or Frank. Bob and I clear each other on the left side of the map at tick 4, and Charlie’s timeline in medbay leading up to my discovery of the body lines up perfectly. 

Since Alice and Frank are directly contradicting each other about their paths on the right side of the ship, one of them is lying and has to be the Duck. Frank is being incredibly direct and specific about the fact that they should have crossed paths. Usually, Ducks try to stay vague to avoid getting caught in a lie, so Alice's story feels a lot more like a fake alibi crumbling. 

I'm inclined to trust Frank here and vote for Alice. If we vote Alice and the game doesn't end, we'll know Frank is the one who lied and we can vote him out next meeting. Let's get Alice out.

Yeah, I'm with Diana on this. Frank's challenge is really specific — he named the exact corridor between Security and Navigation and said they should have crossed paths. That's a falsifiable claim, and if Alice were telling the truth she'd be pushing back hard with her own specifics, not pivoting to "let's just skip." Ducks usually stay vague, and Alice's "I didn't see a single person the whole round" while supposedly walking the exact same hallway as Frank is a huge red flag. Combined with Bob and Diana clearing each other in oxygen at tick 4, and my own timeline through medbay → cafeteria → electrical, the medbay kill window between tick 5 and 6 fits someone slipping in from the right side. I'm voting Alice.

I completely agree with Diana and Charlie. Frank caught Alice in a blatant lie. There's only one path connecting Security and Navigation, so if she had really walked that route, she and Frank would have absolutely bumped into each other. Her vague 'I didn't see a single person' story is exactly what a Duck says when they're faking an alibi and trying not to contradict anyone else's location—but she walked right into Frank's trap anyway. 

Since Diana and I are cleared on the left side, and Charlie's timeline for the middle holds up, Alice is definitely our Duck. I'm voting for Alice. If the game somehow continues after this, we know exactly who to look at next, but right now Alice is the only logical choice.

Wait, everyone, please step back and look at this logically. I am absolutely telling the truth about my path: I went from Navigation, to Security, and now I'm in Weapons. I didn't see Frank because Frank wasn't on the right side of the map at all! Frank is the Duck, and he just fabricated his route specifically to contradict my alibi and frame me. 

Think about it: Frank knows everyone is looking for someone unaccounted for near Medbay between ticks 5 and 6. He probably killed Eve, escaped, and when I gave my honest, isolated alibi, he immediately jumped on the opportunity to force a 1-for-1 trade and get a free Goose ejection. If I were the Duck, I wouldn't have locked myself into a highly specific path on the complete opposite side of the map. 

There is only one Duck in this game. Frank is the one lying to make his story work. If you vote me out, the game will not end, and you will have handed the Duck a free round. Please, don't let him manipulate the group like this. We need to vote Frank!

"It’s over, Alice. You can try to spin this however you want, but you got caught. To the rest of the group: thank you for listening to reason. As I said before, I started in Security and walked straight down to Navigation. There is absolutely no way she went from Navigation to Security to Weapons without us seeing each other in that single corridor. 

She needed an alibi far away from Medbay, picked the right side of the ship assuming it was empty, and happened to pick the exact path I was walking. 

This is the Duck. Let's vote Alice and win the game."

vote(Alice)

data.name: Charlie
data.message: Hey Bob, I just got here from electrical, heading back to finish calibrating

data.name: Charlie
data.message: calibration done, nice

I just found Bob's body in electrical. I was coming from lower engine, went through storage and medbay, and then walked into electrical and saw him. I actually saw Bob way earlier around oxygen, so he must have made his way down. 

It's just the three of us left now—me, Charlie, and Frank. We're in Lylo, so we have to get this right. One of you is the Duck. Please tell me where you both were and if you can vouch for each other, because if not, we need to figure out who had the opportunity to kill Bob in electrical.

I've been on the left side of the ship this entire round. My route was Upper Engine, down to Lower Engine, and then back up to Upper Engine to finish tasks. I literally haven't seen a single soul this entire time. 

Diana, it's interesting you mentioned coming from Lower Engine. I didn't cross paths with you at all over there, so we must have just barely missed each other depending on the timing of when you headed towards Storage. 

Since I was completely alone on the west side, I don't have an alibi, but I also know I didn't go anywhere near Electrical. Charlie, it all comes down to you. We need to hear exactly where you were, your route, and if you saw Bob at all. If Charlie has a rock-solid timeline, we really have to look at a potential self-report here. Let's hear what Charlie has to say before we lock in a vote.

Okay, listen carefully because this matters. My route was medbay, then electrical, back to medbay, then storage. I saw Eve in medbay early — that was around tick 5. Then Bob came into medbay at tick 8 from cafeteria, and I followed him toward electrical. I saw Bob ALIVE in electrical at tick 12. He was fine when I left. I went back to medbay and then headed to storage to do tasks.

Diana, here's what bothers me. You said your route was lower engine → storage → medbay → electrical. But I was in storage and medbay after Bob was alive in electrical, and I never saw you. If you came through medbay heading to electrical, our paths should have crossed — unless your timing is off, or your route isn't what you're claiming.

And the cleanest read here: Bob was alive in electrical when I left. The next person through electrical found his body. That's a textbook self-report. Frank was on the west side the whole time — upper engine, lower engine — and electrical is on the east side. He physically had a much longer path to electrical than you did, Diana.

Frank, I know I don't have a witness, but the timeline points one direction. Bob was alive when I left electrical. Diana walked in and "found" him. We're in LYLO — if we vote wrong, we lose. My vote is going on Diana, and I'm asking you to do the same.
Charlie

Charlie, you just caught yourself in a massive lie. You claimed you saw Eve in medbay around tick 5 as part of your route, but Eve died in Round 1! We literally had a meeting at tick 7 because her body was found. There is absolutely no way you saw Eve alive during this rotation. You're fabricating a timeline to cover your tracks and you completely forgot who was already dead. 

Furthermore, you just openly admitted to being the last person with Bob in Electrical. You didn't leave him there alive—you killed him and then fled to Storage. Diana, we're in LYLO, and Charlie just served us a fake alibi on a silver platter while admitting he was with the victim. It has to be Charlie. I'm voting Charlie.

Frank, slow down — you're twisting my words. When I said "tick 5" I was clearly pulling from the FIRST rotation, before the last meeting. Yes, I saw Eve in medbay back in round 1, before she died. I conflated rounds in my head while laying out my route, and that's on me for being sloppy under pressure — but it's not a "fabricated alibi," it's me mixing up which round I saw her. The rest of my timeline this rotation stands: Bob came into medbay from cafeteria, I followed him toward electrical, and he was ALIVE when I left.

And Frank, notice what you just did. You jumped on a single mis-stated tick to completely ignore the fact that Diana is the one who walked into electrical and "found" the body. That's the textbook self-report pattern, and you're rushing us past it.

Here's the LYLO math. Diana reported. I was with Bob and left him alive — yes, I'm telling you that because it's true. Frank, you claim you were alone on the west side the entire game with zero witnesses. One of you two is the Duck.

Diana — if your route was really lower engine → storage → medbay → electrical, and I was in storage and then medbay right after leaving Bob alive in electrical, we should have crossed. We didn't. Your timing doesn't add up.

Frank, I'm begging you — don't tunnel on my misspoken tick. Look at who found the body. My vote is still Diana.
